Medal awarded to officers and agents of the National Security Force for outstanding acts of courage and devotion. Medal have 3 levels: Corps (Bronze Star), Ministry of Interior (Silver Star) and the Republic (palm). Djibouti Previous article: Star of Valour Prev Next article: Order of the Star of Devotion Next ©
